_comment: The FULL awakening chain from a beat-3-ready fixture (door_awakening_start -- door_understood/recovered_anchor_stone/bought_catalyst all pre-banked) through 3 real sleeps to the GDI line + the awakened pantry_door's interact rewire. Sleeps 1-2 are the SILENT study beats (opaque-until-sleep: ui_sleep_veil_rendered{lines:0}, 'You sleep soundly.' -- no numbers, no hint that anything is progressing); sleep 3 banks door_awakened (accomplishment_recorded, asserted BEFORE the deferred veil coverage event since it fires synchronously earlier in the SAME sleep() call -- the since-marker ordering matters here) and queues the GDI line under the SAME black veil (ui_sleep_veil_rendered{lines:1}, the veil's fourth cameo). Reposition to the pantry_door via `teleport` (debug-only, cross-map since #49 moved the fixture's sleep site to your_bed upstairs) rather than a derived walk route -- this canonical's SUBJECT is the sleep/awakening chain, not inn pathing (ruin_walkthrough/inn_walkthrough already prove the inn is walkable end to end). The trailing `move right` at the destination is a KNOWN blocked bump (pantry_door occupies (14,6), moved against the east wall by playtest hotfix #2 -- was (10,6)) used ONLY to set player_facing -- move_player sets facing before the blocked-cell check, so this never actually steps the player (see wi_game.gd's move_player).
